name: linux-unicode-round-trip-no-mojibake
description: A message body with multibyte UTF-8 (Latin-1 accent, CJK, arrows) must survive the GraphQL transport and render byte-faithful through `poll --full` — no mojibake, no ? substitution, no U+FFFD replacement. The mock's fixture-parse discussion returns a canned vihs-collab-msg@v1 whose msg carries the unicode; poll must echo it intact.
